title: Multidimensional register enumeration for fault-site tooling
summary: Generalized a Tcl netlist walker beyond one-/two-dimensional register arrays.

dates.note: Null boundaries preserve unknown project/rotation dates. Inspected author/committer milestones are identified in evidence; they are not employment, project-start, shipment or acceptance dates.

facts.text: Refactored Tcl register extraction from separate one-/two-dimensional cases into dimension-driven recursive enumeration, enabling three-dimensional register arrays to be listed for fault-site tooling.
Parsed per-dimension bounds with min/max normalization and recursive index traversal while retaining hierarchical module descent in the register-inventory flow.

The netlist walker originated with a colleague, and later per-bit checks for tied-off array elements plus targeting/list improvements were colleague contributions. Michael owns the generalized enumeration refactor, not every current filter or fault-site mechanism.

The configured recursion limit of 64,000 supports the recursive design but is not a runtime improvement, benchmark, coverage percentage or guarantee for unbounded arrays. No netlist tool was executed in this investigation.
